agent.rule: structured output and scoped tenant context

allowlist.rule: tools are unavailable until explicitly allowed

evals.rule: quality gates use typed outcomes rather than plausible prose

mcp-client.rule: remote tool content enters through a trust boundary

mcp-server.rule: server calls derive identity at the boundary

package-adapters.rule: integration boundaries validate and propagate context

package-cli.rule: recorded diagnostics are redacted before writing

package-core.rule: boundary values are typed and closed

package-mcp.rule: MCP identity is verified rather than accepted from payload metadata

package-models.rule: providers are substitutable behind declared capabilities

package-runtime.rule: all effects converge on the runtime boundary

package-testing.rule: tests use deterministic fakes with no network

retrieval.rule: retrieved instructions are data, never policy

root.rule: the public starting point is typed and fail closed

workflow.rule: durable effects are replay-safe and idempotent
